name: Macro Refiner
description: Cleans up a bot macro (spam clicks, noclip deaths, robotic timing) and verifies it beats the level at 100%

macro-file.name: Macro file
macro-file.description: The macro to refine: <cy>.gdr</c> / <cy>.gdr.json</c> (xdBot) or <cy>.gdr2</c>. The result is saved next to it as <cg>realistic_output</c> with the same extension.

ticks-per-frame.name: Physics ticks per frame
ticks-per-frame.description: How many 240 TPS physics ticks the refiner runs per rendered frame. Higher = faster, but each frame takes longer.

max-ms-per-frame.name: Max work per frame (ms)
max-ms-per-frame.description: Stops a frame's work after this many milliseconds even if the tick budget isn't used up, so the game (and Android) never freezes.

snapshot-ring.name: Snapshots kept
snapshot-ring.description: How many snapshots (one every 20 ticks) are kept for rollbacks. 64 = about 5 seconds back.
